title: Secret Order & Guild Cabal
body: Faction sheet for knightly orders, espionage rings, arcane academies, or merchant syndicates operating across borders.

sampleValues.Public Front vs. True Mandate: Poses as an impartial guild of ship insurers while quietly assassinating captains who haul slave cargo or banned relics.
sampleValues.Recognition Signs & Ciphers: A folded corner on a tavern menu plus a silver coin spun counterclockwise.
sampleValues.Ranks & Initiation Trial: Apprentice Scribe -> Auditor -> Red Seal; initiates must forge a flawless customs pass without detection.
sampleValues.Headquarters & Safehouses: Vaults beneath the Clocktower Exchange in Vaelor's Reach.
sampleValues.Allied Houses & Sworn Enemies: Protected by two Harbormasters; hunted ruthlessly by the Silenced Choir.
